provenance.source: PR #4281 "fix: Data leak in ThreadingIntegration between threads", squash-merged 2025-04-15; fix commit a35050694 "fix(threading): Handle channels shadowing (#5299)", closes #5298
provenance.note: introduced by this PR, which reads channels.__version__ inside a block whose only failure handler is ImportError, so a module named channels that has no __version__ raises AttributeError out of setup_once(). By the time of the fix the file had gained an unrelated constant and the block sits two lines lower; the two lines the fix deletes are the ones this diff adds.

keywords: a lookalike package without a version attribute aborts the initialization
the version read is assumed to exist on any module of that name
a shadowing module makes the attribute access raise instead of skipping
initialization crashes instead of disabling the integration
the guard only covers a missing package, so a missing attribute crashes setup
bootstrapping the client fails when a local module of that name has no version
bugs.note: ThreadingIntegration is a default integration and setup_integrations only catches DidNotEnable around its setup_once, so the AttributeError reaches sentry_sdk.init() and the application fails to start. The fix moves `import channels` and the version read into their own try whose handler is `(ImportError, AttributeError)`.
